correctness.rationale: Exact decomposition of all pyramid vertices plus the single apex; volume section scaling and normalized Beta(1,mr+1) height law; two exact block-plus-rank-one covariance identities. A Schur-complement estimate squeezes the least eigenvalue to the rank-one weight and Weyl’s inequality identifies the largest eigenvalue; the two rank-one weights have respectively exponential and inverse-quadratic asymptotics. Exact-rational checker replayed on 24 matrices from three base choices, with 984 entry comparisons. Finite cases are corroboration only; positive definiteness follows from the full-dimensional base.

value.rationale: A natural repeated-product pyramid construction has two canonical sampling laws whose covariance condition numbers separate exponentially versus quadratically, with a sharp universal constant depending on two base spectral invariants and independent of centroid displacement. The family is all fixed full-dimensional convex polytopes rather than an arbitrary finite slice, and it yields the graph-theoretic clique-windmill ratio constant q+2. This precise universality is motivated by comparisons of vertex and volume geometry; no general downstream theorem or numerical census is claimed.
